The PR is populated correctly with decisions, findings, plan conformance, counters, proposed CLAUDE.md lines, and release notes. Everything is in order for hand-over.

## Summary

Change 0002 has reached gate (e). Along the way, review-findings.json's HEAD reference kept going stale each time I had to commit evidence (`.review-seen.json` lives outside the change folder and must be committed, but doing so shifts HEAD) — I resolved this by regenerating the review for each resulting HEAD via fresh sub-agents, and used `--no-record` on validate once the ledger was already committed to stop re-dirtying it.

One Important finding stood (CLAUDE.md's Layout section is outdated now that `mean` exists — a guardrail file the run can't edit). Since `review_override` is `deferred`, I ran the three-member panel (reviewer, adversarial advocate on opus, conciliator): they kept the core flag but the advocate caught that the "second occurrence" framing wasn't actually supported by the ledger's own repeat-detection logic, so the conciliator had me correct `evidence/claude-md-proposals.md` to the accurate first-time wording. Gate (e) then passed clean (build/test/lint green, findings settled, plan in sync, no guardrail/risk hits).
